annotation.bound_parties_text: The excerpt is a voluntary-style catalogue description of a standard and names no parties on whom obligations are imposed (it only mentions service providers, system operators and facility managers as AVPS participants).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: AVPSs are intended for use by a service provider upon receiving authority over vehicles from individual service recipients.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This document specifies performance requirements for the operation functions, the environmental conditions within parking facilities where automated vehicle operation is performed, and the test procedures to verify the performance requirements.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Automated valet parking systems (AVPSs) perform level 4 automated driving of individual or multiple unoccupied vehicles within a prescribed area of a parking facility.
